content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I give, devise, and bequeath to my son, Henry L. Green, all of my personal property, including but not limited to my jewelry, artwork, and furniture.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Real_Property
content_blocks.text: I give, devise, and bequeath to my daughter, Eleanor L. White, my real property located at 456 Elm Street, Crestview, State of Verano, together with all appurtenances thereto.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Executor
content_blocks.text: I appoint Henry L. Green as Executor of this Will and grant him full power and authority to carry out the provisions of this Will.
